## Antigravity CLI: Gemini CLI is now Antigravity CLI

As of June 18, 2026, the <mark>Gemini CLI</mark> service has been discontinued.  
This applies to all tiers — free, Pro, and Ultra — and users have been migrated to use <mark>Antigravity CLI</mark> as the successor.

### Install
```sh
{
    "title": "Install Antigravity CLI"
}
---
$ curl -fsSL https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh | bash
```

### Usage
After installation, you can launch the CLI with the <mark>agy</mark> command.
```sh
{
    "title": "Run Antigravity CLI"
}
---
$ agy
```
